svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 02/12 Langson Library (Rare)
svg.desc: A concrete library from the early campus, all deep windows and shade. The upper floors go very quiet. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
